content: Architecture rules (binding on every CU in this batch): hexagonal layout under src/main/scala/newspipe/ with layers domain > application > infrastructure > control; dependency inversion via domain ports as traits in src/main/scala/newspipe/domain/ports.scala; no cross-layer imports (domain imports java.time plus stdlib only); port flow outbound to inbound; Scala 3.3.4, sbt 1.10.7, Java 21; docs-only batch: checklist under .LLMDD plus build.sbt comment lines; no production Scala file changes.

Legend: CU-ID is the unit id (cu-001, cu-002); CU-TYPE is arch|legend|feature|fix; DTR-COORDINATES are baseline keys the CU traces into (absent key means creation); REQUIREMENTS: states the slice of bugfix-feature-2 delivered; IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: ordered file-level actions each with exact file contents, a Do-NOT-touch list, and a proving command; ACCEPTANCE: maps bugfix-feature-2 test IDs to exact commands plus expected results; per-CU feedback status is PENDING|DONE|ESCALATION.

REQUIREMENTS:
CU-001 creates .LLMDD/ARCH.scala3_compliance_checklist.md with five populated audit sections recording verdicts for given placement, port traits, cross-version shim, boundary audit, and control syntax, closing bug-1 items 1 through 5 and satisfying bugfix-feature-2 criteria 1, 4, 5, and 7.

COORDINATES:
FILE.domain/interfaces.py, TYPE.domain.interfaces.py.class ScraperPort, FILE.infrastructure/kafka.py, FILE.control/main.py. All keys exist in .LLMDD/DTRS/newspipe-scala-baseline/newspipe-python.dtr; the checklist file below is a new creation traced from them.

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. Create .LLMDD/ARCH.scala3_compliance_checklist.md with exactly the content in the markdown fence below. Audit evidence paths inspected for this checklist: src/main/scala/newspipe/domain/ports.scala, src/main/scala/newspipe/infrastructure/KafkaRawPublisher.scala, src/main/scala/newspipe/control/Main.scala, src/main/scala/newspipe/application/IngestionService.scala, build.sbt.
```markdown
# Scala 3 compliance checklist
- Feature: bugfix-feature-2-arch-scala3-compliance
- Fixes: bug-1-arch-scala3-compliance
- Scala: 3.3.4, sbt 1.10.7, Java 21

## 1. given resolution under Scala 3
Verdict: PASS.
Evidence: givens live in object KafkaCodecs in src/main/scala/newspipe/infrastructure/KafkaRawPublisher.scala lines 13-15 as Encoder[Instant] plus Encoder[RssItem]. Call site imports them explicitly with import KafkaCodecs.given in publish at line 21. No package-object givens remain on the Scala path. No implicit keyword remains in src/main/scala.
Criterion: scalafixAll reports no given-in-module ambiguity.

## 2. Trait form for domain ports
Verdict: ACCEPT.
Evidence: ports RssSource, EnrichmentPort, BronzeSink, RawPublisher stay traits in src/main/scala/newspipe/domain/ports.scala (13 lines). Traits keep dependency inversion with zero infrastructure imports. No change to abstract classes; rationale recorded here per bug-1 item 2.
Criterion: grep over src/main/scala/newspipe/domain shows no infrastructure, kafka, spark, delta, rome imports.

## 3. Cross-version dependency shim
Verdict: DOCUMENTED.
Evidence: build.sbt loads spark-sql 3.5.1 Provided plus delta-spark 3.1.0 through CrossVersion.for3Use2_13. Upstream publishes Scala 2.13 artifacts only. ExclusionRule removes scala-xml_3 so scala-xml_2.13 satisfies both Spark and ScalaTest. build.sbt comment lines added in cu-002 point here.
Criterion: sbt compile exits 0 with shim in place.

## 4. Scala 3 boundary audit
Verdict: PASS.
Evidence: layering domain over application over infrastructure over control holds under src/main/scala/newspipe. Application IngestionService in src/main/scala/newspipe/application/IngestionService.scala imports newspipe.domain plus stdlib only. Control Main in src/main/scala/newspipe/control/Main.scala owns all infrastructure imports. Domain files import java.time plus stdlib only.
Criterion: domain grep clean; sbt compile green.

## 5. then-do control syntax consistency
Verdict: PASS.
Evidence: control flow uses Scala 3 form at src/main/scala/newspipe/control/Main.scala line 34 (while true do) with try/catch case, plus src/main/scala/newspipe/application/IngestionService.scala lines 22-25 (match with case) and line 29 (if units.isEmpty then). No while-paren form found in src/main/scala.
Criterion: search for paren-while returns zero hits.
```
Prove: `cat .LLMDD/ARCH.scala3_compliance_checklist.md` prints the checklist with five sections.
2. Run section presence checks over the new checklist at .LLMDD/ARCH.scala3_compliance_checklist.md and confirm each of the five headings exists; cross-check audit evidence in src/main/scala/newspipe/domain/ports.scala and src/main/scala/newspipe/infrastructure/KafkaRawPublisher.scala.
Prove: `grep -c '^## ' .LLMDD/ARCH.scala3_compliance_checklist.md` prints 5.
Do NOT touch: build.sbt, src/main/scala/newspipe/domain/ports.scala, src/main/scala/newspipe/infrastructure/KafkaRawPublisher.scala, src/main/scala/newspipe/control/Main.scala, src/test.
Stop when the checklist file exists with five populated sections and grep prints 5; build.sbt comment lines belong to cu-002.

ACCEPTANCE:
AC-1 (criterion 1): `test -f .LLMDD/ARCH.scala3_compliance_checklist.md` exits 0. AC-4 (criterion 4): checklist section 1 names KafkaCodecs givens plus explicit import site. AC-5 (criterion 5): checklist section 5 names then/do sites in Main plus IngestionService. AC-7 (criterion 7): checklist references bugfix-feature-2-arch-scala3-compliance plus bug-1-arch-scala3-compliance.

REQUIREMENTS:
CU-002 adds cross-reference comment lines to build.sbt documenting the Spark 3.5.1 plus Delta 3.1.0 Scala 2.13 shim and pointing at the cu-001 checklist, then proves the full verification set green, satisfying bugfix-feature-2 criteria 2, 3, and 6.

COORDINATES:
FILE.control/main.py, FILE.control/dependency_layers.py, TYPE.control.dependency_layers.py.class BasePlatformContainer. All keys exist in .LLMDD/DTRS/newspipe-scala-baseline/newspipe-python.dtr; build.sbt is an existing file updated in place.
